messages:
Asha: Quick sync  we need a migration plan for unifying project-scoped API keys and org-scoped keys. Two main asks from product: (1) avoid breaking existing third-party connectors that only accept an "org key", (2) reduce blast radius of long-lived ambient keys.
Tom: TLDR: introduce a translation proxy that accepts existing keys and emits short-lived delegated tokens to downstream services. That buys safety while keeping compatibility.
Ravi: translation proxy ok, but it creates a new trust boundary. Who signs the delegated token? we should have auth-svc sign so downstream can validate without calling proxy.
Asha: agree. delegated tokens = JWT signed by auth-svc with canonical claims: iss, sub, org, project, scopes, aud, jti, exp, and a "orig_key_id" claim so ops can trace back. Also include a signed "billing_attest" claim for billing systems.
Tom: important: downstream RBAC must evaluate against the token claims, not some live rolegraph lookup that still expects "ambient key" semantics. otherwise we get inconsistent permissions mid-migration.
Ravi: propose snapshotting rolegraph at mint time and embedding resolved scope set in token. downstream still run policy evaluation but based on embedded scopes. This avoids late-binding drift.
Asha: downside: when an admin reduces a role, existing tokens could remain valid until expiry. Solution: lightweight revocation list keyed by jti + fast local bloom filter for downstream checks. We'll only require immediate check for high-privilege scopes.
infra-bot: Notice: auth-proxy-staging deployed 2026-04-01T11:02:00Z (rev f2b3)
Tom: billing concern: connectors that only accept an org-key for chargeback need to see a stable billing identity. Include billing_org claim and a billing_signature (HMAC over token claims using billing key) so billing service can accept delegated tokens. Tagging @billing in the RFC.
Ravi: ops concerns: translation proxy could be a target for abuse (turn ambient key -> delegated token). enforce caller authentication (mTLS + service key) and mint policies: only allowed actors and rate limits. also add per-origin metrics.
Asha: compatibility plan (phased):
1) Phase 0: translation proxy in front of downstream (no change to downstream). Proxy performs ENV-only transform and logs.
2) Phase 1: Mint delegated tokens but still allow ambient keys; downstream opt-in to validate delegated tokens when provided (prefer delegated).
3) Phase 2: Downstream require delegated tokens for write paths; ambient keys allowed read-only.
4) Phase 3: Ambient keys deprecated; final enforcement.
Tom: Rollout details: start with non-sensitive endpoints and a canary customer. Use header X-Redwood-Delegated: true to mark transformed requests. Downstream should emit metric 'delegated_auth_used' and 'ambient_auth_used' per route.
Ravi: token format example (pseudo):
```
{
  "iss":"https://auth.redwood.internal",
  "sub":"svc-processor:worker-7",
  "org":"org-777",
  "project":"proj-33",
  "scopes":["read:dataset","write:artifact"],
  "aud":"runtime-service",
  "jti":"jti-abcdef",
  "exp":1769400600,
  "orig_key_id":"key-123",
  "billing_org":"org-777",
  "billing_attest":"sig-base64"
}
```
Asha: Dev ergonomics: provide SDK helpers for minting/refresh and a local dev proxy that can translate a local env var key into a delegated token. Also CLI to revoke jti for testing.
Tom: Security: keys that can call translation proxy should be strictly scoped; create "translation-role" in IAM. Add rate limiting per API key id and per org.
Ravi: migration hazards: long-lived ambient keys in customer infra (apps, CI) will keep working until deprecation. Provide a token-exchange endpoint to let runtime services swap ambient key for a long-lived service-account token scoped to their service (not org-wide). Encourage customers to use service-account tokens rather than ambient org keys.
Asha: action items: I'll draft RFC with token schema, migration phases, runbook, and billing attestation proposal. Tom: you'll add metrics & canary plan. Ravi: you'll add proxy auth and revocation design. I'll post RFC link here and schedule 30m sync with product + billing.
